worker_admission.scope: One extension host, across table, PDF and MAT workers, including starting and stopping children
worker_admission.mechanism: Reserve before spawn; release only failed spawn or actual child exit
worker_admission.basis: Required two-PDF, four-dataset, one-MAT workload plus one slot of headroom

pdf_host.read_watchdog_basis: Native 90000ms cooperative read deadline plus 5000ms host grace; deferred while a mutation or untimed lifecycle operation is pending
pdf_host.accounting: Wire request frames including newline, and serialized operations waiting in the host mutation queue; incoming frames separately capped at 8MiB
pdf_host.limitation: Mutation/open/restore/close execution ceilings remain unqualified. Global RSS/IPC/CPU/temp qualification is separate.

qualification: Process admission is an operational bound. The budgets block is the frozen seven-document containment bound asserted by test/nativeResources.test.ts; it is not an OS sandbox, excludes Code/Chromium, and the 30-minute soak result is recorded separately.

budgets.frozen_at: 2026-11-06T11:15+01:00, before the measurement run that asserts them
budgets.workload: Seven-document: 1 CSV + 1 Parquet + 1 SQLite (200000 rows each), 1 XLSX (50 sheets/500 tables), 2 PDFs (12-page, 5-page image-heavy), 1 generated Level-5 MAT (1003 variables); 20 concurrent rounds plus a retained 100000-row diff
budgets.scope: Native workers only (table, PDF, MAT children). Excludes VS Code, Chromium and the Node host; independent process peaks are compared per class, never summed except for the aggregate row.

table_worker_each.basis: 512MB DuckDB memory_limit (duckdb.rs Config::max_memory) plus 256 MiB held-resource cap (resource.rs) plus 256 MiB headroom for allocator, Arrow and protocol buffers outside the DuckDB limit; spill is 0B (policy.rs max_temp_directory_size). Not an OS-enforced RSS limit.

revision.reason: The hostile-limits run measured one CSV table worker at 869.3 MiB, above the original 768 MiB. 768 summed two caps that do not bound process RSS, so it was a label error, not a ceiling the worker could honour. Revised after measurement, by explicit user decision, with a new operational value (measured peak plus DuckDB 512MB limit, 256 MiB held cap and 256 MiB headroom). Every other budget and pdf_host stay frozen.

pdf_worker_each.basis: No contract number exists. Host-bounded 32 MiB pending bytes and 32 MiB resource reads plus engine page cache; chosen as a round ceiling, not a performance target

mat_worker.basis: 256 MiB variable_bytes decode cap (mat types.rs) doubled for parse and index overhead; huge sparse data never densifies

aggregate_native.basis: Host-owned total for the seven-worker workload; far below the sum of per-class ceilings (4352) because DuckDB engines do not all reach their cap at once

retained_delta_per_worker.basis: Existing PERF-02/03 retained RSS delta; applied to last-third versus middle-third maxima in the soak

cpu.basis: DuckDB thread count from policy.rs plus the protocol thread; PDF and MAT run one engine thread plus I/O

ipc_bytes.basis: 32 MiB frame/result and pending-byte cap shared by table, MAT and PDF hosts; PDF host pending bytes are enforced and tested in pdfHostBounds, not sampled

temporary_bytes.native_scratch: at most the CSV source size (one backup copy); engine spill is 0B
temporary_bytes.pdf_private_work: at most 2 x the summed PDF source sizes (working copy plus one rewritten copy)
temporary_bytes.pdf_recovery: at most 2 x the summed PDF source sizes

handles.basis: Half the macOS default soft limit of 256 for GUI-launched processes

measurements.note: Records observed values only; the budgets above were not edited after this measurement (the one table_worker_each revision is the dated, user-approved record in budgets.rss_mib). Debug (unoptimised) dfv-table 4373174b38c48fa7, dfv-mat 1bab58cb2d4375ff, dfv-pdf af044680f79db92f on Apple M4 / 16 GiB, 100 ms ps sampling, excludes Code/Chromium. Sampling can miss shorter peaks. Supersedes the 2026-11-07T02:56 run on dfv-table a32e1c28 / dfv-mat 3709812f.

seven_document_run.after_shutdown: native scratch empty, all seven workers reaped, no pinned worker process remained

hostile_limits_run.note: Deadline, held-resource-quota, queue and 50 open/close cycles on one CSV worker, asserted against table_worker_each = 1024 (operational, revised 2026-11-07). The earlier a32e1c28 run peaked at 869.3 MiB, which exceeded the original 768 label.
